questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg vil gerne udenfor Europa og havde hørt rigtig godt om Syd Korea

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: SKKU er virkelig gode til at informerer om alverdens tilbud og vigtige tiltag - du bliver taget i hånden hele vejen.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg modtog ikke noget specifik assistance, men vi havde to gode introdage kun for udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
Jeg synes det var en smule svært at finde off housing. Alt kommunikation foregik på koreansk (hvilket var svært til tider). De fleste steder har hverken hjemmeside el. lign. og reservation af et værelse forgår ved at du sender din host et depositum. Jeg endte et rigtig fint sted med en sød host, men kender flere som blev scammet. Jeg anbefaler hjemmesiden:
https://goshipages.com/

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er lækkert at have sit eget sted, fordi hvis du bor on campus skal du bo med en eller flere roommates (aka køjesenge) og har curfew.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: De er ret nemt af registrere sig til kurser. De sender dig en grundig guide og derefter er det bare først til mølle. Jeg fik alle mine ønskede fag.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: En grundig guide + de havde en hotline man kunne ringe til, hvis der opstod problemer.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle mine ønskede fag.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Læs guiden og sid klar inden registering åbner (ligesom at købe koncert-billetter)

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Niveauet var lavt efter min smag, men også ret med en pause fra det akademiske press.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet var lavt, hvilket gøre det nemt at score topkarakter.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Undervisningen mindende meget om herhjemme.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
- Comtemporay Korean History
- Popular Culture and Digital Media
- Understanding Asien Culture

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Dette kursus var helt fantastisk - Understanding Asien Culture - Jeg havde den sødeste underviser.

questions.answer: Alt muligt - sport, sprog udveksling, musik, kunst, dagsture.

questions.answer: KITE Club - det er social klub, hvor man mødes på tværs af koreaner og udvekdslingstudernede og hænger ud.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Mellem - det er sommetider frusterende at du ikke forstår, hvad der forgår omkring dig.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Be open minded :)

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Sproget og deres hierarkiske samfund.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Ikke bo alt fra langt væk, nyd campus byen "Hyewha", ha det sjovt.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Sørg for at have flere creditort med (fx Revolut), nordiske kort bliver ofte afvist.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Få rigtige gode venner.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Social stress - der forgår noget socialt hele tiden, husk at mærk efter og tag dine pauser.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Nej
